description: Deploy a server from your USD balance. BALANCE-ONLY: you must topup_create first (min $30, see topup_bonus for free credit tiers), wait for the topup to confirm, then call this. If your balance is short, returns {insufficient_balance: true, topup_required: true, deficit_usd, topup: {suggested_usd, suggested_bonus, ...}} — call topup_create with that amount and retry. If no account_token is provided, a new account is created and the token is returned — STORE IT. Server is active immediately on success.

account_token.description: optional Bearer token; if absent, a new account is created

dry_run.description: set true for a synthetic deploy preview — no balance debit, no provisioning

os.description: OS slug. RDP must use a win-* slug; GPU must use a Linux + CUDA slug like ubuntu-22-cuda, ubuntu-22-pytorch, ubuntu-22-comfyui, ubuntu-22-ollama.

name: create_order
